sentences.en: I am given a monthly allowance of fifty thousand yen.
sentences.zh: 我每个月有五万日元的生活费。

sentences.en: You must make allowance for his lack of experience.
sentences.zh: 你必须考虑到他缺乏经验。

sentences.en: We ought to make allowances for his difficult situation.
sentences.zh: 我们应该理解他的困境。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：allow（允许）+ance（状态）→允许，容忍
